about_the_game:
The land was absolved, it fell to an ancient darkness, a spell cast by a mysterious force. Two beings from a pure realm of light are the only hope for this consumed land. To purify and restore the land to it's former self one must collect all of the Kai Shards from each of the realm doors in the market town of Kresallia. 

DARKODAI awaits! Note, this is the demo version of the game and contains around two hours of gameplay!

  • Go on a quest to restore the light by collecting all of the Kai Shards in each Darkodai Door that lead to other realms, and maybe encounter a few secrets DARKODAI has to offer...

  • There are many unique characters, friend and foe to meet in the darkness. Be careful who you choose to trust.

  • If quests aren't what you are after then perhaps collecting a few rare items, costumes or companions is more of your style?

  • James and Laura, two beings of light await your guidance, the realm will only become darker under the moonlight the longer they wait...

DARKODAI is powered by the RPG Maker MV engine. The in-game music is from the RPG Maker MV engine!
